ctx.x: In other words, you won the concert. We won the concert by playing all them record numbers. I can understand.

You know, it's a terrible thing of a band rehearsal. Every day for a whole week, get them numbers off the record. You play the record. And we didn't have no tapes like y'all got. No, no. We had to play the record and then stop it. Then watch, most of them horns. Right, yeah. To get them horns to get together, you see, and them pianos. And then lots of them things I had to watch for them drum bricks. Then we'd work on the rhythm section. But the main thing they were, they was featuring that cornet and that…
That's the Hot Five things. Right.
